title: The plaintext login password is not cached in the generic session map, and is reachable only through a dedicated, wipeable pass-through accessor

criteria.given: SessionService creating a session on login
criteria.then: the password is never put into the shared session map that getAllSessionObjects() hands to ~20 callers
it reads the credential from ISessionService.passthroughCredential(), not from the session map

criteria.given: an HTTP session that ends (logout or container expiry)
criteria.then: SessionService wipes the cached credential (a session listener is registered in web.xml)
